body:
This should be resolved somehow, as extractable translations are notoriously incomplete (due to https://github.com/godotengine/godot-editor-l10n/issues/27). However this requires loading each Translation beforehand to check if it's not empty.

I was also thinking of including translated % in the dialog.
Questionable change, but in order to support tres translations, this code had to be moved after format loaders are initialized. I don't know if it doesn't cause any issues, I think it shouldn't.

```suggestion
	/* Set up translations and remaps */
```
While we're here let's fix the grammar here
